constants.covariance: D1: .jack files = one value per gauge configuration (N=603 at L20); jackknife covariance of the mean (qc3.lattice.load_levels), eigenvalue pseudo-inverse (eig_rel_cut 1e-12)
constants.matching: D3: sort both lists ascending, the lowest m QC levels for the m lattice levels (n >= m allowed); n < m: finite penalty 100 sigma per missing level, counted
constants.exclusion: D8: exact free-level solutions of the QC are excluded (qc3.rootscan kind 'free_level')
constants.residue_sign: D9 flag only: zeros with u^T Q' u < 0 stay in the matching and are listed (wrong_sign_zeros)
